prompt_en: A candid, photorealistic street photograph of one adult woman whose visible adult facial features and long, dark, loosely wavy hair are guided by the attached portrait. She stands on a pedestrian bridge just after a shower, with the bridge railing close beside her and the walkway receding into softer distance. Caught in the same instant, her left hand raises the straight shaft of an open transparent umbrella from beside her left shoulder until the canopy clears her head; her right hand holds a small printed route card at chest height, turned toward her eyes. Her face stays visible in three-quarter view as she reads the card, brows gently focused. Wind from camera-right pushes loose hair toward camera-left and tips the canopy slightly toward its source, while her planted feet and quiet weight shift keep her balanced. Fresh droplets cling to the clear canopy and sleeve, and a single shallow puddle near her shoes reflects a small patch of pale sky. The foreground railing has crisp wet texture, the far bridge fades naturally, and soft overcast daylight gives skin, fabric, acrylic, and concrete distinct believable surfaces. Frame this at casual phone height with ordinary observational timing and natural scale. Let the outermost clear canopy rib meet the upper frame edge while the shaft, hands, route card, and face remain readable; the rib continues naturally beyond the crop. Keep the view at a standing observer's phone height with an almost level horizon. A few loose strands visibly begin at her hairline, flow with the main hair toward camera-left, and stay distinct from her cheek contour. Separate three spatial layers: sharply textured rail and pavement nearest the lens, the woman and card in the middle, and the receding far bridge with gently lower contrast in moist overcast air. A pale gap of sky between distant rail posts is visible above its small reflection in the puddle; her shoe partly interrupts that reflection, and the puddle ends against a matte dry strip of concrete.
